name: claude_npc_p2_held_slot_after_reload (C2C-110: selected toolbelt slot + identical-frame twins survive reload; NOT RUN)

steps._note: PRECONDITION: the same save was quit after claude_npc_p2_starting_gear.json (birth NPC with a ranged weapon in logical slot 5 = native toolbelt index 1, so heldSlot==1 before quit) saved the capture p2_man, and after claude_npc_p2_cargo_twins.json for the twins (p2_twins). The summary compared by expectNpcGear already contains per-slot name/count/quality/useTimes/meta/frame, bag[] cells (equal frames stay separate cells), pending, nativeMode. REQUIRED BRIDGE EXTENSION (not owned here): add heldSlot = [int]$n.heldSlot to the $summary in gamebridge.ps1 expectNpcGear (npcgear already emits heldSlot, RebirthGameBridgeNpcGear.cs:54) and re-capture p2_man before quit, otherwise compare= cannot prove the slot.

EXPECT: log 'restored selected toolbelt slot entity=.. sel=1' once; reload-probe selected=0 BEFORE it (engine does not persist the toolbelt) and the npcgear row heldSlot==1; summary equal to p2_man (including the ranged weapon frame in slot 1 and the optional ammo stack in slot 2). Repeat with a second reload: the second run compares against p2_man again (per-instance state, not per-entityId).
